# ISL letter sample images

Six webcam frames of the pilot letters C, L, O, S, U, and V, used by `scripts/check_isl_letters.py`.
The file name is the expected letter.

- Source: `Adipsha_Snapshots/` in [CodingNIL/GestureFlow](https://github.com/CodingNIL/GestureFlow) (MIT License).
- The frames include MediaPipe landmark overlays drawn by the source project.
- These images are not signer-verified. They are only for a sanity check of pretrained models.
